entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. For questions about an existing order, press one. For returns or exchanges, press two.
Two.
Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent. This call may be recorded for quality assurance.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit Customer Support, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I'd like to return an item. It's the VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-7881-B45.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse, delivered about two weeks ago. You're looking to start a return?
That's right. It's just not for me. Is that a problem?

Not a problem at all! We want you to be completely satisfied. Let me just check the return policy... one moment... Ah, yes. You have a 90-day return window with us, so you are well within the timeframe.
Oh, 90 days? That's a relief! I was worried I had missed the cut-off. Okay, perfect. Let's get the return process started then.
Happy to do that for you. Let me just generate the return... Oh. Hang on. Sir, I am so sorry. I need to correct myself. I was looking at the policy for our cycling kits.
What do you mean?
The VeloBand Pulse, being an electronic device, actually falls under our 14-day return policy. And I see here it was delivered 15 days ago. I'm afraid it's no longer eligible for a refund.
Are you kidding me? But **you just said** it was 90 days. You literally just told me I was 'well within the timeframe'. I'm on a **recorded line**, you know.
Sir, I deeply apologize for my error. It was a genuine mistake on my part. The system won't allow me to generate a label for an item that's past the 14-day window.

This is ridiculous! You **promised me** I could return it! Is this some kind of **bait and switch** scheme? Get my hopes up and then deny it? No, that's not acceptable. I want to speak to a supervisor right now.
I understand your frustration, and I apologize again for the miscommunication. Please hold one moment while I get my supervisor on the line for you.
Hello, my name is Maria, I'm a supervisor here at VeloFit. I understand there was some confusion about our return policy?

Confusion? Your agent flat-out lied to me! He told me, on this recorded call, that I had 90 days to return this. I was happy, I was ready to send it back, and then he says, 'Oh, sorry, I was wrong, you're one day too late.' What kind of service is that?

Sir, I want to sincerely apologize for the incorrect information you were given. That is not the standard of service we aim for at VeloFit, and I will be reviewing the call for coaching purposes. Let me take a look at your order and see what options we have.
